name: Alila Marea Beach Resort Encinitas
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary perfectly captures Encinitas' laid-back surf culture while delivering world-class luxury just steps from some of California's most coveted beaches.
whats_special: Alila Marea sits dramatically on bluffs overlooking the Pacific, offering unobstructed ocean views from every room. The resort's design celebrates local heritage with surfboard-inspired architecture and native coastal landscaping. Encinitas is legendary among surfers as the hometown of world champions and home to the iconic Swami's surf break, visible from the hotel.
pro_tip: Book a sunset yoga session on the resort's bluff-top deck during your stay - Encinitas is considered the yoga capital of America, and this spot offers magical golden hour views over the Pacific.
dont_miss: The Self-Realization Fellowship Meditation Gardens next door feature stunning clifftop gardens and koi ponds. Walk to Moonlight Beach for volleyball and bonfires, or explore the quirky downtown filled with surf shops, organic eateries, and the famous Surfing Madonna mosaic that sparked a local art movement.
pros: Direct beachfront location with stunning Pacific Ocean views
Contemporary luxury design with sustainable architecture
Spacious oceanview suites with private terraces
